scope: NPC incoming sampled-damage reductions; PvP and outgoing maximum calculations unchanged

supported_example.interpretation: Historical primary example supports sequential reduction and truncation of the Justiciar residual.

retained_implementation_rules.elysian: Seven of ten proc slots; floor of sampled damage times 3/4.
retained_implementation_rules.dinh: Existing block stance and passive-delay gates; floor of sampled damage times 4/5.
retained_implementation_rules.justiciar: Full set and explicit defence style; floor residual with at least one reduction on a positive hit, nonnegative defence and result clamps.
retained_implementation_rules.ward: Explicit eligibility, demon source and active Ward; subtract floor of one tenth after equipment reductions.
retained_implementation_rules.ordering: Elysian, Dinh, Justiciar, Ward. Caller retains pre-protection-prayer timing.

unresolved: Exact Elysian and Dinh small-hit rounding is retained from the previous implementation and is not independently primary-source verified.
The Justiciar minimum-one and negative-defence edges are current Wiki statements, not independently primary-source verified.
The current Wiki additive-stacking statement has conflicting evidence; implementation retains the historical primary sequential example.
Universal ordering relative to protection prayers remains unproved; this change preserves the existing NPC ordering.
Boss-specific equipment and Ward eligibility is supplied by attack context and requires its own evidence.
